name: HubSpot Engagement Intelligence — Re-engagement Alert v1.5

parameters.content:
### 🔔 RE-ENGAGEMENT ALERT v1.5

**What v1.5 fixes:**

1. BODY EXTRACTION: HubSpot sends payload as
   { headers, params, query, body: [...] }
   We now correctly read body[0], not the wrapper.

2. MISSING previousPropertyValue: HubSpot Starter
   never sends this field. We now alert on ANY
   transition to Active — accept minor false positives
   rather than missing every real re-engagement.

3. REMOVED Merge node: Linear chain means
   $('Parse & Filter Event').first() works fine
   in Build Alert. No merge needed.

**Flow:**
Webhook → Ack (200) [immediate]
        → Parse & Filter → Fetch Contact
                        → Build Alert → Slack

**Fires when:**
  * → Active  ✅  (always alert — can't verify prior)
  Cold → anything better  ✅  (if previousValue present)
  Dormant → anything better  ✅  (if previousValue present)
  Anything → worse status  ❌  exits silently
